description: Titre du poste: Ingénieur en intelligence artificielle (IA) Description du poste Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) ingénieur(e) en intelligence artificielle hautement qualifié(e) pour concevoir et développer des applications alimentées par l'IA de calibre production au sein d'un environnement d'entreprise à grande échelle. Ce rôle soutient des initiatives au sein de l'une des plus importantes organisations d'assurance aux États-Unis, visant à transformer l'expérience des membres grâce à l'intelligence artificielle. L'équipe développe actuellement un assistant basé sur l'IA pour soutenir le traitement des réclamations, ainsi qu'une plateforme intégrée à 360° permettant de créer des profils de santé complets pour les utilisateurs. Ces solutions s'appuient sur des capacités avancées de grands modèles de langage (LLM) et sont soutenues par une vaste plateforme de découverte et d'exploitation des données. Responsabilités Contribuer à la conception et à la mise en uvre de solutions d'IA agentique, notamment pour des cas d'utilisation tels que les jumeaux numériques et les systèmes intelligents destinés aux membres. Concevoir et développer des flux de travail LLM agentiques ou multiétapes de niveau production, incluant la logique d'orchestration et la coordination entre plusieurs composantes d'IA ou services backend. Définir l'architecture système à partir de zéro. Concevoir, développer et intégrer des API RESTful tout en contribuant au développement frontend et backend. Maintenir des pratiques d'ingénierie de niveau production en matière de conteneurisation, de tests, de performance, d'évolutivité et de fiabilité à l'aide de Docker. Participer à des discussions orientées solutions avec les parties prenantes. Compétences essentielles Expérience avec les architectures sans serveur (Serverless) sur AWS et le développement de systèmes de production utilisant AWS Lambda, Amazon Bedrock, API Gateway et DynamoDB. Expertise en Infrastructure as Code (IaC) avec CloudFormation ou Terraform. Expérience en développement full stack et en conception d'API. Maîtrise des pratiques d'ingénierie de niveau production. Solides compétences en communication et expérience auprès des clients ou des parties prenantes. Compétences et qualifications supplémentaires Expérience dans un environnement réglementé par la HIPAA. Bonne connaissance ou expérience significative de développement en Python. Expérience dans les secteurs de la santé ou du gouvernement. Environnement de travail Le travail à distance est possible partout au Canada ou aux États-Unis, à l'exception du Québec. L'environnement est fortement axé sur AWS et offre une exposition à des implémentations de pointe en IA agentique et en grands modèles de langage (LLM). Les ingénieurs auront l'occasion de contribuer à des initiatives d'IA à fort impact à l'échelle de l'entreprise et pourront également participer à d'autres projets après leur engagement initial. Type de poste & Emplacement Ce poste Permanent est basé à Seat

Job Summary This role focuses on designing and optimizing robust data platforms using Apache Iceberg for a hi tech environment ensuring reliable data ingestion storage and access for analytics teams. The professional will work from office in a day shift collaborating with product and engineering partners to deliver scalable data solutions that improve decision making and support innovative digital services for global stakeholders. Responsibilities Design and implement highly scalable data lake and warehouse solutions using Apache Iceberg to support complex analytics and reporting needs in a hi tech product ecosystem. Develop efficient batch and streaming data pipelines that ensure accurate ingestion transformation and partitioning of large data volumes while maintaining strong data quality standards. Optimize data storage layouts file formats and metadata management within Apache Iceberg environments to achieve improved query performance and resource utilization. Collaborate closely with product managers data analysts and software engineers to translate business requirements into well structured data models and reliable data services. Establish robust data governance practices including schema evolution strategies data retention rules and catalog management to maintain consistent and compliant datasets. Implement monitoring and alerting for data workflows by configuring metrics logs and health checks that proactively identify data integrity or performance issues. Create clear technical documentation covering data architecture diagrams pipeline specifications and operational procedures to support knowledge sharing and smooth onboarding. Support performance tuning activities by analyzing query patterns optimizing joins and aggregations and refining clustering strategies within the data platform. Coordinate with security and compliance teams to embed access controls encryption mechanisms and audit trails that protect sensitive information in line with hi tech industry expectations. Provide guidance to stakeholders on using curated datasets and semantic layers effectively so that analytics outcomes directly contribute to product innovation and customer experience improvements. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating emerging data technologies compatible with Apache Iceberg and proposing practical enhancements to the existing stack. Engage in cross functional discussions to ensure data solutions align with organizational objectives and create positive impact on digital services offered to society. Participate in on site collaboration sessions during regular day shifts to resolve data issues quickly and maintain high availability of critical analytical datasets. Qualifications Bring strong hands on experience working with Apache Iceberg in production environments including design of tables partitions and snapshot management for reliable data storage. Demonstrate solid knowledge of data engineering concepts such as ETL development

description: Job Responsibilities Design, develop, and implement scalable data engineering solutions to support PIPL program requirements. Build and maintain end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, SQL, and modern data engineering frameworks. Develop and manage data lakehouse architectures using Apache Iceberg and Snowflake. Create and support a dedicated China data environment on Alibaba Cloud (AliCloud) for data processing, analytics, machine learning, and reporting workloads. Strong hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg. Proven experience working with Snowflake for data warehousing and analytics. Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL development. Experience working with cloud platforms, preferably Alibaba Cloud (AliCloud). Knowledge of distributed data processing technologies such as Apache Spark, Flink, or similar frameworks. Experience with data modeling, performance tuning, and data quality management. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and automation tools. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Experience in regulatory or data privacy-focused environments (PIPL/GDPR) is an added advantage. #LI-CTSAPAC

Design and execute ETL, data warehouse, and data migration tests, including automated data validation scripts using Tosca Data Integrity. Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and transformation rules across source systems, staging layers, and target databases. Perform source-to-target reconciliation and data integrity checks, using SQL queries to validate transformations and load processes. Log, track, and retest defects in partnership with development and data engineering teams. Collaborate with onshore and offshore teams to deliver testing activities and prepare test execution reports and knowledge-transfer documentation. Provide regular status updates, identify risks, and support production validation activities. Strong experience in ETL, data warehouse, and data migration testing, including validation across source systems, staging layers, and target databases. Hands-on SQL query writing and database testing experience with relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or DB2. Strong understanding of ETL processes, data transformations, source-to-target mapping, data reconciliation, and data integrity testing. Ability to analyze business requirements, data models, mapping documents, and technical specifications and translate them into test plans and test cases. Experience with test execution and defect management using tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, or ALM. Experience in Agile/Scrum environments and an onshore-offshore delivery model, with effective cross-functional collaboration. Strong analytical, root-cause analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with clear verbal and written communication. These will help you stand out Insurance domain experience. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. Hands-on experience architecting and delivering enterprise Generative AI and LLM-based applications. Proven experience building AI agents, copilots, RAG solutions, and LLM-powered workflows. Strong knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, retrieval strategies, agent orchestration, and model evaluation. Experience with AWS cloud services, preferably Amazon Bedrock, and cloud-native application architectures. Expertise with APIs, microservices, containers, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and distributed systems. Strong understanding of AI security, responsible AI, governance, observability, and production monitoring. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical and business teams.
